context_notes: Asset Compass is a multi-broker portfolio consolidation app. Microservices: Gateway (React+TS PWA, OAuth2/OIDC via Keycloak, reverse proxy), PortfolioService (Phase 1/core, 10 JPA entities: Asset, AssetRatio, Broker, BrokerAccount, IncomeEvent, Operation, Position, Rebate, TaxEvent, Valuation), TradingService (Phase 4 per in-code architecture notes, no entities yet), NotificationService (Phase 2, no entities yet). Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot 4.0.7 (services)/3.5.15 (gateway), JHipster 9.1.0, Maven, PostgreSQL (1 DB/service), Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes. Known concerns worth surfacing during questioning: domain entity duplication between gateway and portfolioService, thread-unsafe SSE emitter storage (HashMap not ConcurrentHashMap) in KafkaConsumer.java, no Kafka DLQ, minimal input validation on financial DTOs, permissive dev CORS. Full details in .planning/codebase/CONCERNS.md.
